##### Project general facts

Manam Pearl is a contemporary residential development inspired by the elegance and timeless beauty of a pearl. Rising 11 storeys, the project offers a collection of one-, two-and-a-half-, and three-and-a-half-bedroom apartments designed to combine modern architecture with functional living. Spacious open-plan layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and soft natural color palettes create bright, welcoming interiors that emphasize comfort, sophistication, and everyday practicality. Every residence is thoughtfully designed to provide a refined living environment with a seamless balance of style and functionality.

Residents enjoy a comprehensive selection of lifestyle amenities designed for wellness, recreation, and social interaction. The development features a rooftop garden, beach-entry swimming pool, children's splash pool, jacuzzi, fully equipped fitness center, sauna, outdoor cinema, BBQ area, dedicated children's play zones, concierge services, and landscaped communal spaces. Additional conveniences include ground-floor retail outlets, EV charging stations, bicycle parking, Wi-Fi in common areas, and advanced security systems, creating a comfortable and well-rounded residential experience.

The residences feature modern finishing with high-quality materials and are equipped with a Smart Home System for enhanced convenience and everyday comfort. Kitchens come fully fitted with premium German-brand appliances, combining elegant design with reliable functionality. Interiors are finished to a high contemporary standard, offering a sophisticated and durable living environment.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Furjan is a residential community situated in close proximity to Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), and other popular areas in Dubai. It covers an area of approximately 560 hectares and consists of both villas and apartment buildings, offering a diverse range of housing options for residents.

The community is known for its well-planned infrastructure and thoughtfully designed properties. It features a mix of architectural styles, including Arabic, Mediterranean, and contemporary designs, creating a visually appealing and diverse atmosphere.

In terms of amenities, Al Furjan offers a range of facilities to enhance the quality of life for its residents. These include landscaped parks, playgrounds, fitness centers, swimming pools, sports courts, and cycling and jogging tracks. There are also retail centers within the community that provide convenient access to shopping, dining, and other essential services.
